clue.text: 2 for Molly and Poldy

definitions.meaning: a cross-reference to the answer of 2 Down, here meaning comes into flower
Molly and Leopold (Poldy) Bloom, the married couple at the heart of Joyce's Ulysses

explanation.surface: A reference to how a cross-referenced word applies to the Joyce couple.
explanation.walkthrough: 2 Down is OPENS, which a flower does when it flowers; the Blooms, plural, are the husband and wife of James Joyce's Ulysses.
explanation.definitionFit: A flower that opens is said to be flowering; and the surname of the Ulysses couple, made plural, names both of them.

clue.text: Material ordered to dress huge bird

indicators.note: to dress is to clothe, so the word for ordered wraps around the bird

parts.note: bade is the past tense of bid, meaning ordered
the roc is the giant bird of Arabian legend

explanation.surface: Fabric commanded to clothe an enormous bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Brocade is a rich woven fabric with a raised pattern, a type of textile.

clue.text: Initiates in love with Romantics ultimately embracing Pound

indicators.note: embracing means holding within, so the pair of letters goes around the enclosure word

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word Romantics

parts.note: a pound is an enclosure for animals, also called a pen

explanation.surface: Someone in love with the Romantic poets who also admires Ezra Pound starts things off.
explanation.walkthrough: Pound looks like the poet Ezra Pound beside the Romantics, but it is an animal enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: To initiate something is to start it, just as one starts a meeting by declaring it begun.

clue.text: One stops damage when mounting candelabrum

indicators.note: in a down clue mounting means going upwards, so the letters are read from the bottom
the word one stops up, or plugs, the word for damage by sitting inside it

parts.note: to damage is to harm

explanation.surface: Someone prevents harm while climbing up a branched candlestick.
explanation.definitionFit: A menorah is the seven-branched Jewish ceremonial candlestick, a specific kind of candelabrum.

clue.text: Hound finds an elusive burrowing creature

definitions.meaning: to hound is to pester persistently, to nag
a nocturnal black-and-white mammal that digs setts

explanation.surface: A hunting dog tracks down a shy animal that lives underground.
explanation.definitionFit: To badger someone is to harass them; the badger is also the shy, nocturnal digging mammal.

clue.text: Martini shaken puts off 1 Down's neighbour

indicators.note: a cocktail that is shaken has its contents jumbled, so the letters are rearranged
puts off means discards, so one letter is dropped from the jumble

parts.note: the numeral 1 is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A shaken cocktail puts off the drinker who solved 1 Down.
explanation.walkthrough: '1 Down' looks like a cross-reference to BROCADE, but Down is the Northern Irish county and 1 is just I.
explanation.definitionFit: Antrim and Down are adjoining counties of Northern Ireland, so one is the other's neighbour.

clue.text: See stars with really good ecstasy taken in pub

parts.note: something really good is great

indicators.note: taken in means swallowed or received inside, so the drug letter goes inside the pub word

parts.note: a pub is a bar
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone sees stars after a very good pill swallowed in the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: The Great Bear, Ursa Major, is a constellation, a pattern of stars.

clue.text: Rook in tree is knackered and goes to bed

parts.note: R is the chess abbreviation for rook

indicators.note: knackered is British slang for worn out or broken, so the letters are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: A rook perched in a tree is exhausted and turns in for the night.
explanation.definitionFit: To retire for the night is to go off to sleep.

clue.text: Crooked Mr Big near FBI agent and Director

indicators.note: crooked means bent out of shape, so the letters are twisted round

parts.note: a G-man is a government agent of the FBI in American slang

explanation.surface: A corrupt crime boss close to a federal agent, plus a director, in a gangster movie line-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingmar Bergman was the celebrated Swedish film director of The Seventh Seal.

clue.text: See 10
Here one may order round after round

definitions.text: Here one may order round after round

parts.words: Here one may order round after round
parts.note: golfers who finish their round on the course then buy rounds of drinks in the clubhouse bar

explanation.surface: A pub where drinkers keep buying one round of drinks after another.
explanation.walkthrough: The first round is a set of drinks; the second is a round of golf, and the clubhouse bar is nicknamed the hole after the eighteenth.
explanation.definitionFit: Golfers' slang names the clubhouse bar as the hole after the eighteenth, where players drink after a game.

clue.text: Line that woman takes in was knotted

indicators.note: takes in means contains, so the pronoun wraps the jumbled letters

parts.note: that woman is her

indicators.note: a knotted rope is tangled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A rope that a woman pulls in had been tied in knots.
explanation.definitionFit: A hawser is a thick rope or cable used for mooring or towing a ship, a line in nautical terms.

clue.text: Spray with greater frequency pressing rumpled suit

indicators.note: pressing means squeezing, so the adverb hugs the jumbled letters

parts.note: to do something more is to do it more often

indicators.note: rumpled means creased and messed up, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Using a water spray more often while ironing a creased suit.
explanation.definitionFit: Spray is fine droplets of water, a form of dampness or wetness.

clue.text: Flagging energy's signal asset in this!

definitions.text: Flagging energy's signal asset in this!

parts.words: Flagging energy's signal asset in this!
parts.note: flagging looks like tiring, but in a flag-waving signalling system the energy put into waving flags is a notable asset

explanation.surface: Waning stamina, oddly, proves a conspicuous advantage in some activity.
explanation.walkthrough: Flagging normally means tiring and signal means notable; here they mean waving flags and sending messages.
explanation.definitionFit: Semaphore is the system of signalling letters by holding two flags in set positions.

clue.text: Faked apologies odd about tramp appearing in so-called 25

definitions.note: 25 Across is golf; the phrase is the quip about golf attributed to Mark Twain, a noun phrase

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the jumble goes around the tramp word
faked means counterfeited or rigged, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a tramp is a long walk

explanation.surface: Insincere, strange apologies about a vagrant turning up on a golf course.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a phrase: golf is famously described as a good walk spoiled.
explanation.definitionFit: Mark Twain is said to have called golf a pleasant stroll ruined, the famous quip about the sport.

clue.text: 25 supports in river

definitions.meaning: 25 Across is golf; the small pegs a ball sits on for driving support it
a river in north-east England, flowing past Middlesbrough

explanation.surface: Golf supports found in a river.
explanation.walkthrough: It is also the setter's own pseudonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Golf balls are driven from small pegs of that name, and the River Tees flows through Teesside in north-east England.

clue.text: Moved suddenly — photograph ruined

definitions.meaning: as in a pain that went darting up the arm
a snap taken with a camera
worn out or wrecked, as in nerves that are done for

explanation.surface: Someone darted off, and the picture was spoiled.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers darting quickly, a snapshot taken with a camera, and informally being worn out or wrecked.

clue.text: Prow on sloop inclined to be wooden

indicators.note: the prow is the front of a boat, so the front letter of the word sloop is taken

parts.note: inclined means leaning, tilted

explanation.surface: The bow of a small sailing boat leaning over, looking like timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiff, stilted dialogue or acting is described as wooden, lacking natural ease.

clue.text: Freetown's wild countryside area

indicators.note: wild means unruly, so the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: The untamed countryside around the capital of Sierra Leone.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Forest is a national park of heath and woodland in Hampshire, southern England.

clue.text: One's intended to collect new money

indicators.note: to collect means to gather up, so the partner word holds the single letter

parts.note: your intended is your fiance, the person you are engaged to

explanation.surface: A betrothed partner set on collecting fresh cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Finance means funds or capital, money available for spending.

clue.text: See 14
Shakespearean character content to support Iago

indicators.note: content means what is contained, so the letters are inside the words support Iago

explanation.surface: A Shakespeare character is happy to back the villain of Othello.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like 'happy', but it is the contents of the next words.
explanation.definitionFit: Portia is the heroine of The Merchant of Venice who disguises herself as a lawyer.

clue.text: Good to follow girls on Twitter

indicators.note: to follow means to come after, so the good letter goes at the end

parts.note: birds is British slang for young women

explanation.surface: Being good enough to follow young women on the Twitter platform.
explanation.walkthrough: Twitter looks like the social media site; here it is the twittering of birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Twitter is the chirping sound small birds make, their song.

clue.text: Victorious flag officer in the hold

definitions.meaning: the admiral who won at Trafalgar aboard HMS Victory
a wrestling hold gripping the opponent's neck from behind

explanation.surface: A winning admiral in the cargo hold of his ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Admiral Horatio Nelson won at Trafalgar in HMS Victory; a full or half nelson is a wrestling grip.

clue.text: Winter Olympian's weapon

definitions.meaning: a competitor who races a small sledge feet first, with 's meaning is

explanation.surface: The arm carried by a competitor at the Winter Games.
explanation.definitionFit: A luge racer rides a small sled feet first; the Luger is a German pistol.

clue.text: Gang brought in to pull massive vehicle

indicators.note: brought in means put inside, so the gang word sits within the pulling word

parts.note: to strain is to pull hard
a gang is a team

explanation.surface: A crew is recruited to haul a huge vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam train is a heavy railway locomotive and carriages, a large vehicle.

clue.text: Sport where learner driver in bewilderment's reversed

indicators.note: reversed means run backwards, so the letters are read in the opposite order
in means placed within, so the learner letter goes inside the fog word

parts.note: to be in a fog is to be bewildered
L is the learner plate on a British learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A sport where a learner driver backs up in a state of confusion.
explanation.definitionFit: Golf is a sport played with clubs and a small ball over a course.

clue.text: Hoax over rubbish presented as decree

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the hoax word is read backwards

parts.note: to kid is to fool, a hoax
tat is British slang for cheap rubbish

explanation.surface: A prank about junk is passed off as an official order.
explanation.definitionFit: A diktat is an order imposed by an authority without consultation, an edict.

clue.text: Be annoyed about children crowding round

indicators.note: crowding round means surrounding, so the offspring word encloses the short word for about

parts.note: seed means offspring or descendants
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Getting irritated when kids cluster around.
explanation.definitionFit: To see red is an idiom meaning to become very angry.
